regime_context: Detector shows a dominant one-narrative structure in Canadian equities: Oil & Gas Producers (XEG.TO) leads decisively by rank and is the only theme both eligible and highly durable (breadth 0.93, durability 0.71), while rotation is narrowing (only 6 of 16 themes trend-eligible) and non-directional.
